responsibility: Implements GCC’s decimal floating-point support for REAL_VALUE_TYPE using the decNumber library and IEEE 754 decimal32/64/128 encodings. It converts between decimal REAL_VALUE_TYPE values and strings, integers, binary reals, and encoded storage formats; performs decimal arithmetic, truncation, min/max, sign operations, and mode-specific max-value construction; and handles endian-sensitive packing/unpacking of decimal formats for the compiler’s constant-folding and real-number machinery.
same_name_distinction: Provides the executable decimal floating-point support behind gcc/dfp.h, with decNumber-based conversions, IEEE decimal32/64/128 packing and unpacking, arithmetic, truncation, and integer conversion; the header only declares those decimal helper entry points.
